description: Lists backups newest first with backupId, startTime, sizeBytes, reason (daily, manual, upload, freeze, reset, config-change) and exportState (idle, exporting, ready). Pass backupId to restoreBackup, cancelBackupRestore, startBackupExport, getBackupDownloadUrl (exportState ready) or deleteBackup. Name a backup to the user by its time and reason; never show its backupId.
